customerSettings.title: Settings
customerSettings.homeTitle: Put it on your home screen
customerSettings.homeBody: Opens like an app, one tap away.
customerSettings.aboutKeep: What we keep: your first name, your order (dishes, pickup or delivery, note) and your language, with the kitchen you ordered from. If you allow notifications, your browser's notification address for that order.
customerSettings.aboutNever: What we never keep in the cloud: your phone number and your address. You send those to the seller on WhatsApp, and they stay on the seller's phone.
customerSettings.aboutDevice: On this phone: your orders list, your first name for the next order, the last kitchen you used, and your language and theme, in this browser only. Clearing the site data removes them.
customerSettings.aboutNotify: Notifications: only if you allow them, only for the orders saved on this phone. They are removed when an order is cancelled or when the kitchen finishes its week.
customerSettings.aboutHow: How long: order details are deleted 4 weeks after the cooking day. Only an empty marker stays, so an old link says it is archived.
customerSettings.aboutFind: Find my order: wrong tries keep a scrambled form of your internet address for about an hour at most, to stop guessing.
customerSettings.aboutNo: No accounts, no ads and no payments in the app.
